answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the knoll graph. Re-attestations are stored in garden and meadow lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, so holding a position calls for ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 147 impostors cost 1114 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
